states.RESEARCH: HYPEVAULT_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=research. DINOv3 research route allowed. Legacy DINOv2 route remains DINOv2.
states.SHADOW: HYPEVAULT_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=shadow. DINOv3 research route allowed. No fallback onto DINOv2.
states.LEGACY_PRODUCTION: Unset or production. Legacy DINOv2 route may run. DINOv3 is blocked.
states.PRODUCTION_BLOCKED: Empty, malformed, or unknown mode. DINOv3 is blocked. The mode is not treated as research.
